reviews.text:
This one is saving me from cracked damaged skin barrier this winter. 
it just smells amazing, feels amazing and works amazing. 
It's very thick tho and can definitely clog your pores a bit if overused. but I don't think this is a negative thing when the alternative is a cracked flakey mess. just knowing it you can take the proper action to avoid it.

will not work for you if you don't like fragrance on skincare products tho, so that's something to consider.
reviews.zh: 今個冬天，呢款救咗我受損嘅皮膚屏障，令佢冇再裂開。香味好正，感覺好正，效果都好正。不過佢好厚身，如果過量用，肯定可能會堵塞毛孔一啲。但我覺得呢個唔算壞嘢，因為相比起裂開、脫皮嘅皮膚，呢個已經好啲。只要知道呢點，就可以採取適當嘅措施避免。不過，如果你唔鍾意護膚品有香味，呢款可能唔適合你，呢點要考慮下。

reviews.text: This has fixed my damaged skin after an illness and hospital stay stripped my skin barrier and left me with red, irritated, sore skin across my cheeks. It's thick, creamy but quickly absorbed. My skin feels very hydrated and cared for; the redness cleared in three days of use day and night. I do wish it came with a small spatula but that's nitpicking. I do have dry skin all year round and need a lot of hydration. I love this cream and will repurchase.
reviews.zh: 呢款修復咗我因為生病同住院而受損嘅皮膚。住院令我皮膚屏障受損，面頰紅、刺痛、痛楚。佢質地厚身、奶霜狀，但吸收好快。皮膚感覺好水潤、被照顧好；日夜都用，紅咗三日就已經退晒。我真係希望佢有附一支小刮刀，但係呢個只係小事。我全年都係乾性皮膚，需要好多補濕。我好鍾意呢款面霜，會再買。

reviews.text: Super rich formula that layers over other products nicely! It’s very smoothing when applied but doesn’t give me that glow that I like. It’s more of a smooth and matte finish when absorbed. The formula is really nice and gentle on the skin and didn’t cause me any irritation. Not a massive fan of the scent but I do like that it is completely natural and from the propolis!
reviews.zh: 配方好豐富，疊喺其他產品上面都好好！搽嗰陣好順滑，但係冇我鍾意嗰種光澤。吸收之後比較係順滑、啞光嘅效果。配方真係好好，對皮膚溫和，冇令我刺激。我唔係好鍾意佢嘅香味，但我好鍾意佢係完全天然嘅，並且係由蜂膠製成！

reviews.text:
I've search for so long for a dry skin moisturizer. I took advice from many friends and influencers and tried so many so called 'intense moisturizers' and none worked the way I wanted. But one day I had the chance to try this one in store... It's just the best for dry skin or combination skin with dry patches. It truly hydrates your skin all day or all night and leave a very nice glow. If you have dry skin this will make your skin feel youthful, smooth and plump.
I'm not going back to any other moisturizer personally.
reviews.zh:
我搵咗好耐嘅乾性皮膚保濕霜。我聽咗好多朋友同網紅嘅建議，試過好多所謂「高效保濕」產品，但冇一款可以達到我想要嘅效果。直到有一日我喺店入面有機會試吓呢款……佢真係乾性皮膚或者有乾燥斑塊嘅混合皮膚嘅最佳選擇。佢可以全日或者整晚都真係為皮膚補濕，並留低好靚嘅光澤。如果你皮膚乾，呢款會令你皮膚感覺年輕、順滑、飽滿。
我個人就唔會再用返其他保濕霜。

reviews.text: This is one of my favorite creams from the Korean market. It makes the skin as beautiful and nourished as possible, evens out the color and works great with the skin barrier. Despite its dense balm texture, the cream layers well on various serums without leaving a feeling of heaviness. Makeup is also easy to apply on it and nothing rolls off afterwards. It does not clog pores, and the skin looks and feels rested. I order this cream again and again for myself, almost my entire family and at the request of many friends. Everyone is really delighted with it!
reviews.zh: 呢款係我喺韓國市場最愛嘅面霜之一。令皮膚盡量靚同有滋養，膚色更均勻，對皮膚屏障都好有效。雖然質地係濃稠嘅膏狀，但係疊喺各種精華上面都好好，唔會有厚重感。化妝都容易，化完之後亦唔會起卷。唔會堵塞毛孔，皮膚睇落同感覺都好休息。我為自己、差唔多全家人，以及應朋友要求，一買再買。大家都好高興！

reviews.text: During winter time my skin becomes so dry and flaky. This helps my skin from damaged skin barrier. Its creamy texture makes my skin so hydrated and soothing. It does a lovely job to make my skin feel pleasant but still plumps. I notice considerably less redness and irritation when I use this.
reviews.zh: 冬天嗰陣我嘅皮膚會好乾同起皮。呢款幫我減低皮膚屏障受損嘅情況。奶霜質地令我皮膚好水潤、舒緩。佢令皮膚感覺舒服，同時仍然飽滿。用呢款之後，明顯減少咗泛紅同刺激。

reviews.text: This cream is very thick, it feels more like a balm to me. I have combination skin that is also sensitive. My UZone gets pretty dry & flaky, especially in the last week of my cycle. This cream is perfect for target application in the areas my skin feels extra dry! I use it at night like a sleeping mask, the cream is so soothing! My skin always looks less flaky and more normal the next morning.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜好厚身，對我嚟講似一隻膏狀嘅護膚膏。我係混合同敏感嘅皮膚。我 U 區好乾、會起皮，尤其係月經周期嘅最後一個星期。呢款啱晒用喺皮膚特別乾嘅位置！我晚上當睡眠面膜咁用，面霜好舒緩！第二朝我皮膚通常都冇咁起皮，睇落更正常。

reviews.text: Still need to try the emulsion of this line, but so far this might be the best of the line, this cream is solid... but once you work it with your fingers it melts into an oil and spreads well; it is as nourishing as occlusive and emollient, tho there are a lot of oils here it is not at all fragrant. Unless you are sensitive to one of the oils, it is a very good product for the dry skins or normal to combo as a sleeping mask, since it is breathable, does not clog up your skin and does not leave the common yellow cast of propolis.
reviews.zh: 我仲未試過呢系列嘅乳液，但到目前為止，呢款可能係呢個系列最好嘅。呢款面霜係固體……但係用手指搓開之後會融成油，推得開；滋養性同封閉性都好好，雖然含有好多油，但完全冇香味。除非你對其中某種油敏感，否則對於乾性至偏乾混合皮膚嚟講，呢款係一款好好嘅睡眠面膜產品，因為佢透氣、唔會堵塞皮膚，而且唔會留低蜂膠常見嘅黃色色調。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
